references.text: The Lord drove out great and mighty nations before Israel, a theme repeated in Joshua 23:9
Describes the great and mighty nations that the Lord was to drive out before Israel
Moses reminds Israel that the great and mighty nations will be driven out and that no one can stand against them
The promise that no one will be able to stand against Israel when the Lord puts fear into the nations
God's promise to Joshua that no one will be able to stand against him all the days of his life
The Lord assures Joshua that none of his enemies will be able to stand against him
The Lord fought for Israel, confirming that no one could stand against them
The Lord gave Israel rest from all their enemies, and no one could stand against them
The Lord promises to drive out the nations before Israel gradually
The Lord promises to drive out the nations and expand Israel's borders
